'''Petras Vaitiekūnas''' (born 26 March 1953, in [[Liudvinavas]], [[Marijampolė County]]) is a Lithuanian [[politician]] who was the [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Lithuania)|foreign minister]] of [[Lithuania]] from 2006 to 2008.

Petras Vaitiekūnas was a signatory to the [[Act of the Re-Establishment of the State of Lithuania|Lithuanian declaration of independence in 1990]] and a member of the [[Lithuanian Supreme Council]] from 1990 to 1992. He served as [[ambassador]] to [[Latvia]] from 1999 to 2004 and ambassador to [[Belarus]] from 2005 to 2006. He was appointed Foreign Minister of Lithuania on 12 July 2006.<ref name=government>{{cite web | url = http://www.lrv.lt/main_en.php?cat=16&gr=3&sub=23 | title = Petras Vaitiekūnas (Minister of Foreign Affairs) | access-date = 2007-11-14 | publisher = Government of the Republic of Lithuania | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20031028163312/http://www.lrv.lt/main_en.php?cat=16 | archive-date = 2003-10-28 | url-status = dead }}</ref>
